name: Meta Platforms
tagline: Three billion users and an ad machine, spending heavily on AI.
strengths: Network effects across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp
weaknesses: Huge AI and Reality Labs spending
thesis: AI is already lifting ad performance
Valuation is reasonable for its growth
moat: Network effects and data scale. Durable, though attention can shift to new apps.
outlook: Core ads are healthy. The question is whether the AI spend earns a return; watch capex against revenue growth.
changeMind: Capex rising while revenue growth slows would drop it to Hold
method: Quick screen, not a full analysis: moat, red flags, headline ratios and relative valuation.
